providers.title: Finite sets are measure universal
providers.scope: Every measurable set A of positive measure contains x + sF for every finite set F and every 0 < s <= s_0, for some s_0 > 0. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Geometric progressions are not measure universal (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every q in (0,1) and eta in (0,1) there is a compact E in [0,1] with m(E) > 1 - eta containing no affine copy x + s{q^n : n >= 1}, s != 0. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Periodic hitting sets
providers.scope: For every p in (0,1) there is an open 1-periodic set H of density at most 6p such that every x + t q^n, x real, t in [1,2], meets H for some n >= 1; proved in the fourth lesson. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Nested dyadic grids
providers.scope: N_b = 2^ceil(log2(c q^-b)) satisfies c q^-b <= N_b < 2c q^-b with c = 4/(1-q); finer keys determine coarser keys; keys are constant on segments without grid points. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spans of windows on an ordered tree
providers.scope: The windows below a vertex of height h occupy sigma_h consecutive integers, and the block of an edge leaving height h spans at most 2 r_h integers. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Stable centers keep earlier keys
providers.scope: The unstable centers have density at most 4Kc q^(g+1), and at a stable center the points x + t q^n of a window keep the keys of x in all earlier grids. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separation within a window
providers.scope: The points x and x + t q^n, n in one window, have pairwise distinct keys at the window's resolution and every finer one. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Mean density of the routed random set
providers.scope: The random 1-periodic set B defined by routing points through selector tables to terminal tables of Bernoulli(p) bits has expected density p. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Routes without a default choice
providers.scope: The route of a fixed center makes no default choice with probability (1 - 2^(1-M))^d. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The route is preserved at stable centers
providers.scope: At a stable center, the points of the windows below the first default vertex U follow the route of the center to U, and a successful local test puts them in B. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Independent tests at a fixed scale
providers.scope: Conditionally on the exposure of a stable center with a default choice, all (M-1) r local tests at a fixed dilation fail with probability exactly (1 - p/2)^((M-1) r). No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: All dilations at a stable center
providers.scope: Conditionally on such an exposure, some dilation t in [1,2] misses B at all window indices with probability at most D_{M,q}(r) e^(-p(M-1)r/2). No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Misses at stable centers
providers.scope: With the chosen parameters, a stable center is missed at some dilation with probability at most 2p. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
